name: Lazarus
overview: The story of Lazarus, a man from Bethany and brother to Mary and Martha, highlights the deep love Jesus had for this family, as seen in John 11:5. When Lazarus fell sick, his sisters sent word to Jesus, who declared that the sickness would ultimately glorify God and the Son (John 11:3-4). This narrative underscores the divine purpose behind Lazarus's illness and the intimate relationship between Jesus and those He loved.
